final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT sf.zoneref AS site_code, s.entrystat AS access_status, AVG(sf.traitcount) AS avg_traitcount, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanfeatures AS sf INNER JOIN sites AS s ON sf.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sf.traitcount >= 489 GROUP BY sf.zoneref, s.entrystat) SELECT site_code, access_status, avg_traitcount, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS record_fraction FROM grouped ORDER BY record_fraction DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
